answer: Sequential work-depth licensing: each new agent identity must submit a distinct proof-of-work chain whose last block solves a puzzle seeded by the prior block's hash and a dune field from a public entropy snapshot, so answers cannot be copied across identities. A ripple of dependent hashes forces serial computation per identity, while a sable quota caps total registrations per entropy epoch. An attacker pays one full chain per sybil, multiplying compute cost linearly and blocking batch reuse.
